\doxysubsubsection{\texorpdfstring{read\_fort10()}{read\_fort10()}}
{\footnotesize\ttfamily \label{fort10__io_8f90_af3d1caa9f658602b608b84757fba860d} 
subroutine read\+\_\+fort10 (\begin{DoxyParamCaption}\item[{integer, intent(in)}]{ufort10}{}\end{DoxyParamCaption})}



Reads wavefunction data from fort.\+10 file. 

This subroutine reads wavefunction parameters and settings from a fort.\+10 file. It handles both periodic and non-\/periodic boundary conditions, and supports Crystal periodic basis sets with complex wavefunctions.


\begin{DoxyParams}[1]{Parameters}
\mbox{\texttt{in}}  & {\em ufort10} & Unit number for the fort.\+10 input file\\
\hline
\end{DoxyParams}

\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item Reads PBC settings (PBC, PBC\+\_\+T, PBC\+\_\+C)
\item Handles tilted cells and complex wavefunctions
\item Processes Crystal periodic basis set definitions
\item Sets up gamma point calculations 
\end{DoxyItemize}

\doxysubsubsection{\texorpdfstring{read\_fort10\_fast()}{read\_fort10\_fast()}}
{\footnotesize\ttfamily \label{fort10__io_8f90_aa50ca743867d301cf219ff7ddffe10c5} 
subroutine read\+\_\+fort10\+\_\+fast}



Fast version of fort.\+10 file reader. 

This subroutine provides a faster implementation for reading wavefunction parameters from the fort.\+10 input file. It handles periodic boundary conditions and various wavefunction parameters.


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item Reads PBC settings (PBC, PBC\+\_\+T, PBC\+\_\+C)
\item Processes wavefunction parameters and orbital occupations
\item Handles both real and complex wavefunctions
\item Supports Crystal periodic basis sets 
\end{DoxyItemize}

{\footnotesize\ttfamily \label{fort10__io_8f90_afd243edbec1c69bb8c2689fae0a1c71a} 
subroutine update\+\_\+kiontot}



Updates the kiontot and kiontotj arrays for atomic orbital information. 

This subroutine updates two arrays\+:
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item kiontot\+: Stores atomic orbital information for determinant part
\item kiontotj\+: Stores atomic orbital information for Jastrow part
\end{DoxyItemize}

The arrays are populated based on shell information, multiplicities, and occupation numbers from both determinant and Jastrow parts.

Writes wave function parameters and symmetries to a file. 

This subroutine writes various wave function parameters and symmetries to the specified file unit, including PBC parameters, electron numbers, shell information, and matrix elements.
